final_answer:
THERMAL ANALYSIS
Building: Modular-Aid-Shelter-v1
Climate zone: Warm & Humid
Overall assessment: Overheating risk detected in Kerala (Warm & Humid): indoor operative temperature (34.2 °C) exceeds NBC 2016 adaptive 90% comfort limit (31.95 °C) due to uninsulated dark roof and low air speed.

THERMAL CONSTRAINTS AT RISK / VIOLATED

1. HIGH INDOOR OPERATIVE TEMPERATURE (ADAPTIVE – NATURALLY VENTILATED)
   Current: 34.2 °C
   Threshold: 31.95 °C (Neutral 29.57 ± 2.38 °C)
   Status: VIOLATED
   Why: Indoor temperature exceeds adaptive comfort band for naturally ventilated Indian residences (Trm = 31.0 °C).
   Source: TERI-2021 Table 2

2. INSUFFICIENT AIR SPEED FOR TEMPERATURE OFFSET
   Current: 0.25 m/s
   Threshold: 0.5 - 1.5 m/s
   Status: VIOLATED
   Why: Air movement is insufficient to provide the 3-5 °C physiological cooling offset documented in Indian field studies.
   Source: TERI-2021 §5, Fig. 37, Table 9

3. COOL-ROOF QUALIFICATION FAILURE
   Current: 0.35 dimensionless
   Threshold: Initial reflectance >= 0.60 (or high SRI)
   Status: VIOLATED
   Why: Roof lacks reflective treatment, causing extreme solar absorption and radiant downward heat flux.
   Source: TERI-2021 §4.9

4. ROOF INSULATION BELOW CODE PRESCRIPTION
   Current: 0.8 m²·K/W
   Threshold: >= 3.5 m²·K/W
   Status: AT_RISK
   Why: Uninsulated envelope allows excessive conductive heat gain into the living volume.
   Source: TERI-2021 Table 5

5. HIGH RELATIVE HUMIDITY LIMITING EVAPORATIVE COOLING
   Current: 78.0 % %
   Threshold: Qualitative limit (>70% reduces wet-bulb depression)
   Status: AT_RISK
   Why: High humidity suppresses sweat evaporation; requires air speed 0.5-1.5 m/s rather than evaporative coolers.
   Source: TERI-2021 §4.6

SUGGESTIONS
1. Apply High-SRI Cool-Roof Paint or Bamboo Shading Screen to the roof deck. – expected effect: Measured indoor temperature reduction of 2.0 - 4.0 °C (TARU-2015). (Source: TARU-2015 §2 & §4)
2. Enlarge operable wall openings to achieve >= 20% floor area ratio with opposite cross-apertures. – expected effect: Increases natural air velocity past occupants to 0.5 - 1.2 m/s. (Source: TERI-2021 §4.4.5)
3. Operate ceiling fans or natural air currents to provide 0.5 - 1.5 m/s air speed. – expected effect: Offsets elevated indoor operative temperature by 3.0 - 5.0 °C (TERI-2021 Fig. 37). (Source: TERI-2021 §5 & Table 9)
4. Extend deep roof eaves/overhangs to >= 0.8m. – expected effect: Blocks direct solar radiation on opaque walls and shields window openings from monsoon rains. (Source: TERI-2021 §4.5)

IMPROVEMENTS
1. Change cool_roof_treatment
   Current -> Recommended: None (Bare Dark Surface, SRI ~ 0.35) -> High-SRI Cool Roof Paint (Reflectance >= 0.60, Emittance >= 0.90)
   Reason: Lowers roof surface temperature and eliminates downward radiant ceiling heat flux (TERI-2021 §4.9).
   Expected thermal effect: 2.0 - 4.0 °C indoor operative temperature reduction (TARU-2015) (Source: TARU-2015 §2, p. 18)
2. Change operable_opening_area
   Current -> Recommended: 66.4 % of floor area -> >= 20.0 % of floor area (with opposite cross-vents)
   Reason: Restores required natural ventilation air exchange rate (TERI-2021 §4.4.5).
   Expected thermal effect: Elevates indoor air velocity to 0.5 - 1.2 m/s, offsetting 3 - 5 °C (TERI-2021 Table 9) (Source: TERI-2021 §4.4.5 & §5)
3. Change roof_overhang
   Current -> Recommended: 0.60 m -> 0.90 m
   Reason: Provides passive solar interception on glazing and opaque envelope (TERI-2021 §4.5).
   Expected thermal effect: Prevents direct solar radiant heat gain spikes during midday insolation (Source: TERI-2021 §4.5)

COST IMPACT (2014 INR)
1. High-SRI Cool Roof Paint (₹25/sq.ft × 370.0 sq.ft): INR 9,250.00
2. Wall aperture enlargement & bamboo shutter framing: INR 1,500.00
3. Roof rafter extensions for deep overhang eaves (0.9m): INR 2,500.00
Total estimated: INR 13,250.00
Note: Costs are historical (2014 market rates); current market prices NOT PROVIDED in source documents.

UNCERTAINTIES / MISSING DATA
1. solar_reflectance_sri – Unmeasured roof SRI assumed 0.35 based on conventional untreated material. (Perform spectrophotometer surface reflectance measurement.)
2. indoor_air_velocity – Air speed estimated from window opening ratio and ambient wind speed. (Perform hot-wire anemometer measurement in living zone.)

SOURCES
- TERI-2021: Thermal Comfort Prescription for Cooling Dominated Indian Residential Buildings
- TARU-2015: Handbook on Achieving Thermal Comfort within Built Environment – Volume II
